name: ehbp
description: JavaScript client for Encrypted HTTP Body Protocol (EHBP)

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const dir of ['dist/esm', 'dist/cjs']) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:core && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/copy-core.js dist/esm/gen && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/esm/package.json
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/copy-core.js dist/cjs/gen && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > dist/cjs/package.json
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:browser

author: Tinfoil
